insights.insight: 11,932 cryptographically verified receipts spanning grocery, auto parts, dining, fuel, and digital SaaS represent confirmed purchase events — not behavioral inference. At $971K cumulative GMV, the dataset is large enough to benchmark category-level spend patterns against probabilistic ad-targeting assumptions.

insights.topic: Unknown category is the largest GMV bucket
insights.insight: The 'Unknown' category accounts for $109,460 — 29.3% of 14-day GMV — driven by SaaS and digital receipts that existing classification systems haven't caught up to. For brands operating in digital services, this is where verified spend signal is accumulating fastest.

Active verified purchase signals now span Maine, Tennessee, Missouri, Idaho, Nebraska, Iowa, and other non-metro CBSAs — not just urban anchors. Brands whose mass-market distribution extends beyond top-25 DMAs have a rare opportunity to validate reach in markets where panel-based measurement historically underperforms.

insights.topic: NAPA Auto Parts as second-ranked brand by receipt count
insights.insight: NAPA Auto Parts at 87 verified receipts over 14 days ranks second only to Walmart in the top-brand list, confirming that automotive parts retail is a durable and material share of verified spend — not a sampling artifact. Auto aftermarket brands should note this category is already represented in the receipt graph.

Token velocity has dropped to 0.944x with acceleration at 0.999x — the first sub-1.0x reading since the April 12 record high. Week-over-week throughput is contracting; the $1M milestone arrives on residual momentum, not growth. Post-milestone trajectory is the more relevant planning signal for brands evaluating data volume commitments.

insights.topic: 10 DKIM vendors confirm digital receipt verification is live
insights.insight: Verified vendors include Stripe, Paddle, Amazon, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gumroad, and Suno — meaning digital subscription and SaaS purchase receipts are being cryptographically authenticated alongside physical retail. For brands in software, media, or fintech, this pipeline is already capturing their category's purchase events.
